questions.question_text: Read the provided unseen passage context tracking the impact of artificial intelligence on the modern workforce. Based on the passage, what is the primary socioeconomic concern regarding rapid AI integration?
options: A) The immediate obsolescence of all hardware engineering roles
B) The displacement of routine cognitive jobs without adequate retraining frameworks
C) The universal enhancement of creative industries without regulation
D) The excessive consumption of global renewable energy resources
questions.answer: B) The displacement of routine cognitive jobs without adequate retraining frameworks

questions.question_text: Choose the option that best defines the word 'ubiquitous' as used in the context of the passage's description of AI tools.
options: A) Extremely rare and expensive
B) Found everywhere and deeply integrated
C) Outdated and inefficient
D) Confined to laboratory settings
questions.answer: B) Found everywhere and deeply integrated

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank based on the passage: The author argues that AI is not merely a technological shift, but fundamentally a ________ transformation.
questions.answer: socio-economic

questions.question_text: According to the text, how does artificial intelligence specifically impact creative industries, contrasting with its effect on data-entry roles? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: While AI automates and displaces repetitive data-entry roles, it acts as a collaborative catalyst in creative industries. It accelerates brainstorming and drafting processes, allowing human creators to focus on high-level conceptualization rather than basic execution.

questions.question_text: What specific proactive measures does the author suggest governments and corporations should implement to mitigate job displacement? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The author suggests establishing widespread, subsidized upskilling programs, fostering public-private partnerships for lifelong learning, and creating robust social safety nets to support workers transitioning from obsolete roles to newly emerging tech-centric sectors.

questions.question_text: Draft a suitable title for the passage and summarize its central theme in one comprehensive sentence. [15-25 words]
questions.answer: Title: The AI Workforce Revolution. Theme: AI's rapid integration demands urgent socio-economic adaptations and comprehensive retraining frameworks to balance automation with human employment.

questions.question_text: Identify the option that correctly converts the given active sentence into the Passive Voice: 'The committee had already reviewed the annual financial report before the board meeting.'
options: A) The annual financial report was already reviewed by the committee before the board meeting.
B) The annual financial report had already been reviewed by the committee before the board meeting.
C) The annual financial report has already been reviewed by the committee before the board meeting.
D) Before the board meeting, the committee has been reviewing the annual financial report.
questions.answer: B) The annual financial report had already been reviewed by the committee before the board meeting.

questions.question_text: Change the following sentence into Indirect Speech: She said to the manager, 'Why is my replacement order delayed?'
options: A) She asked the manager why her replacement order is delayed.
B) She told the manager why her replacement order was delayed.
C) She asked the manager why her replacement order was delayed.
D) She enquired from the manager that why was her replacement order delayed.
questions.answer: C) She asked the manager why her replacement order was delayed.

questions.question_text: Parse the sentence and identify the type of subordinate clause used: 'The scientist who discovered the breakthrough cure was awarded the Nobel Prize.'
options: A) Adverbial Clause
B) Noun Clause
C) Relative (Adjective) Clause
D) Principal Clause
questions.answer: C) Relative (Adjective) Clause

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate modal indicating strict obligation: 'You _____ submit the historical research assignment by 5 PM today, otherwise it will not be graded.'
questions.answer: must

questions.question_text: Complete the sentence applying the correct rule of Subject-Verb Concord: 'Neither the principal nor the teachers _____ (was/were) present in the auditorium during the rehearsal.'
questions.answer: were

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the correct determiner: 'Since the patient arrived late and the venom had spread, there is _____ (little/a little) hope of his complete recovery.'
questions.answer: little

questions.question_text: Combine the following two simple sentences into one complex sentence using a relative clause: 'The manuscript is on the top shelf. It belongs to the chief editor.'
questions.answer: The manuscript which is on the top shelf belongs to the chief editor.

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the correct advanced tense form of the verb in brackets: 'By the end of next month, she _____ (live) in this metropolitan city for exactly ten years.'
questions.answer: will have been living

questions.question_text: Write a formal Letter of Complaint to the Customer Service Manager of Apex Electronics, New Delhi, regarding a newly purchased high-end laptop that exhibits severe battery drainage and overheating issues. Demand a prompt replacement or refund. [120-150 words]
questions.answer:
To
The Customer Service Manager,
Apex Electronics, New Delhi.

Subject: Complaint regarding defective laptop (Invoice #45892).

Sir/Madam,
I am writing to express my immense dissatisfaction with a laptop (Model X-200) purchased from your store on 12th October. Barely a week into its use, the device has begun exhibiting severe battery drainage, lasting barely an hour on a full charge. Furthermore, it overheats dangerously during basic word processing tasks, posing a safety hazard.

As a student, this malfunction has severely disrupted my academic schedules. I expected superior quality and reliability from a reputed brand like yours. Since the product is well within the warranty period, I urgently request a complete replacement of the defective unit or a full refund at the earliest.

I have enclosed a copy of the invoice and the warranty card for your reference. Prompt action will be highly appreciated.

Yours sincerely,
Rahul Verma

questions.question_text: Write a short summary brief / analytical paragraph highlighting the critical importance of integrating mental health awareness and counseling infrastructure within modern school curriculums. [100-120 words]
questions.answer: The integration of mental health awareness and counseling infrastructure in modern schools is no longer a luxury but an absolute necessity. Today's students navigate a highly competitive academic environment, intense peer pressure, and the pervasive influence of social media, leading to rising rates of anxiety and depression. Schools serve as the primary developmental ecosystem for adolescents; thus, equipping them with professional counselors ensures early detection of psychological distress. Incorporating mental wellness into the curriculum normalizes seeking help and dismantles associated stigmas. Ultimately, a proactive approach to psychological well-being fosters emotional resilience, ensuring students are not just academically competent, but also mentally equipped to handle real-world challenges.

questions.question_text: Read the following extract from 'The Peacock': 'I was told that you have to sit quite still. / Then a peacock will come to you.' What does this suggest about the nature of observing the peacock?
options: A) It is a loud, communal activity
B) The bird is easily tamed and domesticated
C) It requires immense patience, silence, and reverence for nature
D) The bird is attracted to sudden, erratic movements
questions.answer: C) It requires immense patience, silence, and reverence for nature

questions.question_text: In Anton Chekhov's 'The Lament', the line 'Iona shifts about on his seat as if he were on needles' is used. What emotion does Iona's physical body language predominantly convey?
options: A) Intense physical cold and frostbite
B) Deep psychological agitation and a desperate, suffocating need to share his grief
C) Eagerness to earn money from his next passenger
D) Anger towards his horse's sluggish pace
questions.answer: B) Deep psychological agitation and a desperate, suffocating need to share his grief

questions.question_text: In D.H. Lawrence's 'The Rocking-horse Winner', how does Paul's mother define 'luck', and how does this twisted definition directly affect Paul's psychology? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Paul's mother defines luck as the inherent ability to have and make money. This materialistic definition deeply affects Paul, driving him into a frantic, obsessive quest to 'find luck' on his rocking-horse to win his mother's elusive love.

questions.question_text: According to William Shakespeare in 'Let me Not to the Marriage of True Minds', how does time (Time's fool) affect true love? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Shakespeare asserts that true love is not 'Time's fool'. While time inevitably destroys physical beauty and youth (Time's bending sickle), it has absolutely no power to alter or diminish genuine, spiritual love, which endures until the end of doom.

questions.question_text: Why does the narrator compare his watch to a living creature in Mark Twain's essay 'My Watch'? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Twain compares the watch to a living creature to emphasize its erratic, unpredictable, and almost mischievous behavior. By personifying the watch, he humorously exaggerates its mechanical failures and the immense frustration of relying on incompetent watchmakers.

questions.question_text: What does the 'tiger moustache' symbolize in Mulk Raj Anand's story 'A Pair of Mustachios'? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The 'tiger moustache' symbolizes feudal pride, caste superiority, and rigid societal hierarchy. Ramanand's wearing of it represents a disruption of this traditional social order, sparking intense, irrational fury in the arrogant aristocrat, Azam Khan.

questions.question_text: Analyze how Ted Hughes utilizes the hawk as a central metaphor for absolute, unchecked dictatorial power and arrogance in the poem 'Hawk Roosting'. [100-120 words]
questions.answer: In 'Hawk Roosting', Ted Hughes crafts a chilling monologue from the perspective of a hawk to symbolize absolute, unchecked dictatorial power. The hawk's worldview is entirely egocentric; it believes the entire universe, including 'Creation', exists solely for its convenience. Lines like 'I kill where I please because it is all mine' highlight a terrifying, sociopathic arrogance mirroring human tyrants. The hawk rejects sophistry, morality, and argument, representing a raw, primal fascism that relies on brute force ('the tearing off of heads'). Hughes effectively uses the bird's predatory nature to critique totalitarian regimes that maintain order through violence and refuse to allow any change or challenge to their absolute authority.

questions.question_text: Discuss Bertrand Russell's three governing passions as outlined in 'My Three Passions', and explain how they have shaped his personal and intellectual journey. [100-120 words]
questions.answer: In 'My Three Passions', Bertrand Russell identifies three deeply consuming forces that have governed his life: the longing for love, the search for knowledge, and an unbearable pity for the suffering of mankind. Love provided him with ecstatic relief from the profound loneliness of existence, offering a mystical vision of heaven. The search for knowledge drove his intellectual journey, compelling him to understand the hearts of men, the mechanics of the stars, and the Pythagorean power of mathematics. However, his ultimate grounding was pity; the agonizing cries of children in famine and victims of oppression continuously pulled him back to earth. Together, these passions created a holistic intellectual who sought truth while remaining deeply empathetic to human tragedy.
